system.description:
Cunei Myrgha Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Rare, Air. No item slots. Attunement.

Prerequisites: Society:Legalism[1], Proficiency[3]

You have an organizational mantra that reflects the organization of a leaf.

Organizing Mantra (Passive): When you are attuned to the Ritual of the Maple Leaf, increase your RIS by half your Proficiency, rounded up.

Rulebook p.47.
